count: 71
# Theme rules outside their theme's folder, as they stood on 22 November 2026 (build id PL12, slice PL12b;
# ADR-152 Amendment 4). One line per rule: path under OspreyFlow_Core, a key that survives a line moving
# (the rule's selector with its @media condition, whitespace collapsed; a long one is cut and ends in a
# hash of the whole), and the kind (rule, string-rule, font-entry, font-face, font-use, custom-property).
# Tab-separated. `python -m tools.theme_rule_check --list` prints what the check finds now.
#
# THE LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. The first line is the number of entries below, and the check
# (tools/theme_rule_check.py, shown red and green by tests/glass_trees/test_theme_rules.py) fails if the
# file holds more or fewer entries than it records, if an entry's rule is no longer found (a stale entry:
# delete it), if a rule is found that no entry excuses, or if the count is above RATCHET_CEILING in the tool.
#
# How it reaches zero. A slice that removes a rule, or moves it into the theme's own folder
# (OspreyFlow_Core/packages/themes/<name>/, PL12d), deletes that rule's line, lowers `count:` above and
# lowers RATCHET_CEILING in the tool to the same figure. Any slice that removes a rule may do this; no
# other change to this file is allowed. NOBODY MAY RAISE THE COUNT, or add a line, without the owner's word.
# The list reaches zero when the React GOV.UK look is retired: one release after the cutover, by a build of
# its own, on the owner's word at that time (ADR-152 Amendment 4, item 8). Until then a Default build still
# carries the React workspace's GOV.UK component rules, and no text says otherwise.
#
# What the entries are, by file: the GOV.UK brand blocks of the shared tokens, the shared primitives and
# panel type, and the GDS Transport entry of the fonts list (all five move to the GOV.UK theme folder in
# PL12d); the React workspace's five component stylesheets that name the brand (they stay until the React
# look is retired, and nothing here moves them); and the sign-in theme's two rules in a Python string in
# harness/keycloak_theme.py (harness/govuk_chrome.js holds no CSS rule, only markup and selectors in code).
# The count was raised from 70 to 71 on the owner's word of 24 November 2026 for PL7c's identity-switch rule [data-brand="govuk"][data-govuk-typeface="on"], which moves to the GOV.UK theme folder in PL12d (the entry is then deleted and the count lowered, as above).
